html:
France-Albert René was the president of the Seychelles from 1977, when he overthrew the first president in a coup, until 2004.

The Seychelles became independent from Britain on 29 June 1976 with James Mancham as president and René as prime minister. A year later, while Mancham was in London, René's supporters seized power. He made the country a one-party socialist state in 1979, and survived a mercenary invasion in 1981 that was foiled at the airport.

He used the islands' tourism money for free schooling and health care while jailing or exiling opponents. Multiparty elections returned in 1993, and he won them. His party kept power until 2020, under his chosen successor.
